findings.note: An Aug 19, 2026 Rotowire item says new head coach Mike McCarthy rested Rodgers for a preseason game, so Rodgers is still the Steelers QB. No report from this week on his injury status or whether he will start was found.

In the Dec 28, 2025 game against Cleveland, Rodgers had one rush for six yards. That shows he can clear 0.5 yards, but it was a single carry, so one kneel-down or zero scrambles would make the over lose.

Late in 2025, Rodgers, then 41, played with a cast on a fractured left wrist, took several big hits and briefly left a game. This points to limited mobility and a past of missing time, which hurts a rushing-yards over. This is old reporting, not news from this week.
